verdict.rationale: Asana markets 'Asana Dash — Your AI Chief of Staff' and AI Teammates that draw context from the Work Graph and shared memory, suggesting an in-workspace Q&A assistant, but no evidence describes citation of specific workspace items in answers or an 'ask a question, get instant answer with citations' UX. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of citation/sourcing behavior in AI answers, hands-on or independent verification of accuracy/citations.
